dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Guten Tag, Frau Schneider. Schön, dass Sie gekommen sind.
dialogue.translation: Good day, Ms Schneider. Nice that you came.
dialogue.translation_en: Good day, Ms Schneider. Nice that you came.
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat siang, Ibu Schneider. Senang Anda datang.

dialogue.speaker: candidate
dialogue.text: Guten Tag, Herr Weber. Vielen Dank für die Einladung.
dialogue.translation: Good day, Mr Weber. Thank you for the invitation.
dialogue.translation_en: Good day, Mr Weber. Thank you for the invitation.
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat siang, Tuan Weber. Terima kasih atas undangannya.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Könnten Sie mir etwas über Ihre Berufserfahrung erzählen?
dialogue.translation: Could you tell me something about your work experience?
dialogue.translation_en: Could you tell me something about your work experience?
dialogue.translation_id: Bisakah Anda menceritakan sedikit tentang pengalaman kerja Anda?

dialogue.speaker: candidate
dialogue.text: Gerne. Ich habe fünf Jahre im Vertrieb gearbeitet und zwei Jahre ein kleines Team geleitet.
dialogue.translation: Gladly. I worked in sales for five years and led a small team for two years.
dialogue.translation_en: Gladly. I worked in sales for five years and led a small team for two years.
dialogue.translation_id: Dengan senang hati. Saya bekerja lima tahun di bidang penjualan dan dua tahun memimpin tim kecil.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Warum möchten Sie zu uns wechseln?
dialogue.translation: Why would you like to switch to us?
dialogue.translation_en: Why would you like to switch to us?
dialogue.translation_id: Mengapa Anda ingin pindah ke kami?

dialogue.speaker: candidate
dialogue.text: Ihr Unternehmen ist für Innovation bekannt, und ich würde gern an spannenden Projekten mitarbeiten.
dialogue.translation: Your company is known for innovation, and I would like to work on exciting projects.
dialogue.translation_en: Your company is known for innovation, and I would like to work on exciting projects.
dialogue.translation_id: Perusahaan Anda dikenal inovatif, dan saya ingin ikut mengerjakan proyek-proyek menarik.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Das klingt gut. Wir melden uns nächste Woche bei Ihnen.
dialogue.translation: That sounds good. We will get back to you next week.
dialogue.translation_en: That sounds good. We will get back to you next week.
dialogue.translation_id: Kedengarannya bagus. Kami akan menghubungi Anda minggu depan.

dialogue.speaker: arzt
dialogue.text: Guten Tag, Herr Berg. Was kann ich für Sie tun?
dialogue.translation: Good day, Mr Berg. What can I do for you?
dialogue.translation_en: Good day, Mr Berg. What can I do for you?
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat siang, Tuan Berg. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Ich fühle mich seit einer Woche müde und habe Kopfschmerzen.
dialogue.translation: I have felt tired for a week and have headaches.
dialogue.translation_en: I have felt tired for a week and have headaches.
dialogue.translation_id: Sudah seminggu saya merasa lelah dan sakit kepala.

dialogue.speaker: arzt
dialogue.text: Haben Sie auch Fieber oder Husten?
dialogue.translation: Do you also have a fever or a cough?
dialogue.translation_en: Do you also have a fever or a cough?
dialogue.translation_id: Apakah Anda juga demam atau batuk?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Nein, nur die ständige Müdigkeit. Ich schlafe gut, aber ich bin trotzdem müde.
dialogue.translation: No, just the constant tiredness. I sleep well, but I am still tired.
dialogue.translation_en: No, just the constant tiredness. I sleep well, but I am still tired.
dialogue.translation_id: Tidak, hanya kelelahan terus-menerus. Tidur saya nyenyak, tapi tetap lelah.

dialogue.speaker: arzt
dialogue.text: Ich möchte gern Ihr Blut untersuchen. Wir machen einen Bluttest.
dialogue.translation: I would like to examine your blood. We will do a blood test.
dialogue.translation_en: I would like to examine your blood. We will do a blood test.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya ingin memeriksa darah Anda. Kita akan tes darah.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Ist das ernst?
dialogue.translation: Is it serious?
dialogue.translation_en: Is it serious?
dialogue.translation_id: Apakah ini serius?

dialogue.speaker: arzt
dialogue.text: Wahrscheinlich nicht. Oft liegt es am Eisenmangel. Wir wissen es nach dem Test.
dialogue.translation: Probably not. It is often due to iron deficiency. We will know after the test.
dialogue.translation_en: Probably not. It is often due to iron deficiency. We will know after the test.
dialogue.translation_id: Mungkin tidak. Seringnya karena kekurangan zat besi. Kita akan tahu setelah tes.

dialogue.speaker: vermieter
dialogue.text: Guten Tag, Herr Vogt. Das ist die Wohnung im dritten Stock.
dialogue.translation: Good day, Mr Vogt. This is the apartment on the third floor.
dialogue.translation_en: Good day, Mr Vogt. This is the apartment on the third floor.
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat siang, Tuan Vogt. Ini apartemen di lantai tiga.

dialogue.speaker: interessent
dialogue.text: Die Wohnung ist sehr hell. Wie groß ist sie?
dialogue.translation: The apartment is very bright. How big is it?
dialogue.translation_en: The apartment is very bright. How big is it?
dialogue.translation_id: Apartemennya sangat terang. Berapa luasnya?

dialogue.speaker: vermieter
dialogue.text: Sie hat 72 Quadratmeter mit zwei Schlafzimmern.
dialogue.translation: It has 72 square meters with two bedrooms.
dialogue.translation_en: It has 72 square meters with two bedrooms.
dialogue.translation_id: Luasnya 72 meter persegi dengan dua kamar tidur.

dialogue.speaker: interessent
dialogue.text: Und wie hoch ist die Kaltmiete?
dialogue.translation: And how much is the rent excluding utilities?
dialogue.translation_en: And how much is the rent excluding utilities?
dialogue.translation_id: Dan berapa sewa tanpa utilitas?

dialogue.speaker: vermieter
dialogue.text: Die Kaltmiete beträgt 850 Euro, plus Nebenkosten 120 Euro.
dialogue.translation: The rent excluding utilities is 850 euros, plus 120 euros in additional costs.
dialogue.translation_en: The rent excluding utilities is 850 euros, plus 120 euros in additional costs.
dialogue.translation_id: Sewa tanpa utilitas 850 euro, plus biaya tambahan 120 euro.

dialogue.speaker: interessent
dialogue.text: Das ist etwas mehr, als ich geplant hatte. Können wir verhandeln?
dialogue.translation: That is a bit more than I had planned. Can we negotiate?
dialogue.translation_en: That is a bit more than I had planned. Can we negotiate?
dialogue.translation_id: Itu sedikit lebih tinggi dari rencana saya. Bisakah dinegosiasi?

dialogue.speaker: vermieter
dialogue.text: Wir können uns auf 800 Euro einigen, wenn Sie langfristig bleiben.
dialogue.translation: We can agree on 800 euros if you stay long term.
dialogue.translation_en: We can agree on 800 euros if you stay long term.
dialogue.translation_id: Kita bisa sepakat 800 euro kalau Anda tinggal jangka panjang.

dialogue.speaker: kunde
dialogue.text: Guten Tag, ich möchte im Sommer nach Österreich reisen.
dialogue.translation: Good day, I would like to travel to Austria in the summer.
dialogue.translation_en: Good day, I would like to travel to Austria in the summer.
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat siang, saya ingin bepergian ke Austria pada musim panas.

dialogue.speaker: angestellte
dialogue.text: Sehr gern. Haben Sie schon eine Vorstellung, wohin es gehen soll?
dialogue.translation: With pleasure. Do you already have an idea where it should go?
dialogue.translation_en: With pleasure. Do you already have an idea where it should go?
dialogue.translation_id: Dengan senang hati. Apakah Anda sudah punya gambaran mau ke mana?

dialogue.speaker: kunde
dialogue.text: Wir würden gern nach Salzburg fahren und dort eine Woche bleiben.
dialogue.translation: We would like to go to Salzburg and stay there for a week.
dialogue.translation_en: We would like to go to Salzburg and stay there for a week.
dialogue.translation_id: Kami ingin ke Salzburg dan tinggal di sana seminggu.

dialogue.speaker: angestellte
dialogue.text: Eine gute Wahl. Soll ich ein Hotel in der Nähe des Zentrums buchen?
dialogue.translation: A good choice. Should I book a hotel near the center?
dialogue.translation_en: A good choice. Should I book a hotel near the center?
dialogue.translation_id: Pilihan bagus. Perlukah saya memesan hotel di dekat pusat kota?

dialogue.speaker: kunde
dialogue.text: Ja, bitte mit Frühstück, wenn es möglich ist.
dialogue.translation: Yes, with breakfast please, if possible.
dialogue.translation_en: Yes, with breakfast please, if possible.
dialogue.translation_id: Ya, dengan sarapan kalau memungkinkan.

dialogue.speaker: angestellte
dialogue.text: Selbstverständlich. Und möchten Sie auch einen Ausflug zur Festung Hohensalzburg?
dialogue.translation: Of course. Would you also like a trip to the Hohensalzburg Fortress?
dialogue.translation_en: Of course. Would you also like a trip to the Hohensalzburg Fortress?
dialogue.translation_id: Tentu. Apakah Anda juga ingin wisata ke Benteng Hohensalzburg?

dialogue.speaker: kunde
dialogue.text: Das klingt perfekt. Wie hoch wären die Gesamtkosten?
dialogue.translation: That sounds perfect. What would the total cost be?
dialogue.translation_en: That sounds perfect. What would the total cost be?
dialogue.translation_id: Kedengarannya sempurna. Berapa total biayanya?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Miriam, hast du schon einen Umzugsunternehmer gefunden?
dialogue.translation: Miriam, have you already found a moving company?
dialogue.translation_en: Miriam, have you already found a moving company?
dialogue.translation_id: Miriam, sudah menemukan perusahaan jasa pindahan?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Noch nicht. Ich habe drei Angebote bekommen, aber die Preise sind sehr unterschiedlich.
dialogue.translation: Not yet. I have received three offers, but the prices are very different.
dialogue.translation_en: Not yet. I have received three offers, but the prices are very different.
dialogue.translation_id: Belum. Saya sudah dapat tiga penawaran, tapi harganya sangat berbeda.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Worauf kommt es bei der Wahl an?
dialogue.translation: What matters when choosing?
dialogue.translation_en: What matters when choosing?
dialogue.translation_id: Apa yang penting saat memilih?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Zum einen der Preis, zum anderen, ob sie die Möbel ab- und wieder aufbauen.
dialogue.translation: On the one hand the price, on the other whether they assemble and disassemble the furniture.
dialogue.translation_en: On the one hand the price, on the other whether they assemble and disassemble the furniture.
dialogue.translation_id: Di satu sisi harga, di sisi lain apakah mereka membongkar dan memasang kembali furnitur.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ich kann dir eine Firma empfehlen, die ich selbst genutzt habe. Sie war zuverlässig.
dialogue.translation: I can recommend a company that I used myself. It was reliable.
dialogue.translation_en: I can recommend a company that I used myself. It was reliable.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya bisa merekomendasikan perusahaan yang saya pakai sendiri. Sangat dapat diandalkan.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Das wäre toll! Schick mir bitte den Kontakt.
dialogue.translation: That would be great! Please send me the contact.
dialogue.translation_en: That would be great! Please send me the contact.
dialogue.translation_id: Itu bagus sekali! Tolong kirimkan kontaknya.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mache ich. Soll ich am Umzugstag helfen?
dialogue.translation: I will. Should I help on moving day?
dialogue.translation_en: I will. Should I help on moving day?
dialogue.translation_id: Akan saya lakukan. Perlukah saya membantu saat hari pindahan?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Tom, hast du schon Pläne fürs Wochenende?
dialogue.translation: Tom, do you already have plans for the weekend?
dialogue.translation_en: Tom, do you already have plans for the weekend?
dialogue.translation_id: Tom, sudah punya rencana akhir pekan?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ich hatte gedacht, ins Kino zu gehen, aber ich bin mir noch nicht sicher.
dialogue.translation: I had thought about going to the movies, but I am not sure yet.
dialogue.translation_en: I had thought about going to the movies, but I am not sure yet.
dialogue.translation_id: Aku tadinya berpikir mau ke bioskop, tapi belum yakin.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wärst du interessiert, stattdessen eine Radtour zu machen?
dialogue.translation: Would you be interested in going on a bike tour instead?
dialogue.translation_en: Would you be interested in going on a bike tour instead?
dialogue.translation_id: Apakah kamu tertarik bersepeda santai sebagai gantinya?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Das wäre eine tolle Idee! Das Wetter soll schön werden.
dialogue.translation: That would be a great idea! The weather is supposed to be nice.
dialogue.translation_en: That would be a great idea! The weather is supposed to be nice.
dialogue.translation_id: Itu ide bagus! Kata ramalan cuacanya bagus.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Dann treffen wir uns am Samstag um zehn am Hauptbahnhof.
dialogue.translation: Then we meet on Saturday at ten at the main station.
dialogue.translation_en: Then we meet on Saturday at ten at the main station.
dialogue.translation_id: Kalau begitu kita bertemu Sabtu jam sepuluh di stasiun utama.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Gut. Soll ich etwas zu essen mitbringen?
dialogue.translation: Good. Should I bring something to eat?
dialogue.translation_en: Good. Should I bring something to eat?
dialogue.translation_id: Baiklah. Perlukah aku membawa makanan?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ja, wir können unterwegs ein Picknick machen. Bis Samstag!
dialogue.translation: Yes, we can have a picnic along the way. See you Saturday!
dialogue.translation_en: Yes, we can have a picnic along the way. See you Saturday!
dialogue.translation_id: Ya, kita bisa piknik di perjalanan. Sampai Sabtu!
